title: Paul Mellon's walking stick

tellings.quote: I was told it was Paul Melon's washing stick.

plain: Harald Malmgren, who advised American presidents and says he handled UFO material directly, tells Michels about an object in Virginia that he says was Paul Mellon's walking stick. Mellon was a wealthy heir and art collector. Malmgren gives nothing more than "I was told it was Paul Mellon's walking stick," so he is passing on what someone else told him, and what made the stick worth mentioning is left unsaid.
